argv:
for name in omztty ztty ssmcp zfetch zdot zshard; do
    selected=$(command -v "$name")
    selection_exit=$?
    printf '__OMZTTY_PATH__ %s %s %s
' "$name" "$selection_exit" "$selected"
    printf '__OMZTTY_VERSION_BEGIN__ %s
' "$name"
    "$name" --version
    version_exit=$?
    printf '__OMZTTY_VERSION_END__ %s %s
' "$name" "$version_exit"
    if [[ $selected = /* && -f $selected ]]; then
        printf '__OMZTTY_HASH__ %s ' "$name"
        /usr/bin/sha256sum -- "${selected:A}"
    fi
done
